question.problem:
The table below represents the ages of players of a volleyball team. 

| Student | James | Robert | Charles | Daniel | Thomas | David |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Age (years) | $11$ | $9$ | $9$ | $10$ | $11$ | $10$ |

$$

$$

What is the ratio of players who are aged $10$ years or more to those who are less than $10$ years old?
question.worked_solution:
From the table, there are $4$ players (James, Daniel, Thomas, David) whose age is $10$ or more years.

There are $2$ students (Robert, Charles)  whose age is less than $10$ years.

So the ratio of students whose age is $10$ or more years to those whose age is less than $10$ years is $4:2.$
